name: LiteParse
description: Parses PDFs, Office files, and images locally into markdown, JSON with bounding boxes, or plain text for agents and RAG pipelines, from a CLI or Rust, Node.js, Python, and WASM libraries.

skills.name: Markdown Output
skills.description: Renders documents to structured Markdown with headings, tables, lists, images, and links, ready to pass to an LLM or RAG pipeline.

skills.name: Selective OCR
skills.description: Runs bundled Tesseract OCR only where native text is missing, or sends pages to an HTTP OCR server such as EasyOCR or PaddleOCR.

skills.name: Complexity Check
skills.description: Checks cheaply whether a document needs OCR or heavier parsing, so a pipeline can route, reject, or estimate cost before a full parse.

skills.name: Page Screenshots
skills.description: Generates PNG screenshots of all or selected pages at a custom DPI so vision-capable agents can look at the rendered page itself.

skills.name: Batch And Worker Parsing
skills.description: Parses whole directories with lit batch-parse, or many files in Python or Node.js worker pools with hard per-parse timeouts.
